[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] '''Davaire Colmar''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] soldier who deserted from an elite [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] unit during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. Colmar was tall and strong, with a chiseled jaw and close-cropped graying brown hair.

==Biography==
[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] Davaire Colmar was a promising [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officer]] in the [[Imperial Special Training Corps/Legends|Imperial Special Training Corps]], putting him on the fast track to promotion in the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]]. Colmar commanded an assault trooper unit during the [[assault on Dalron IV]]. Colmar's unit was attacked by a mob of almost 2,000 civilians armed with [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Outnumbered nearly fifty to one, and with communications cut off by a malfunction caused by [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|orbital bombardment]], Colmar's unit was only able to make two calls for help before being overwhelmed.<ref name="GG9" />

Although he suffered a head wound in the battle, Colmar managed to escape with his life. Cut off from friendly units, Colmar wandered aimlessly for two [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. During this time, Colmar had a crisis of confidence brought about by the scenes of carnage which he witnessed. It was obvious to Colmar that there had been a number of massacres perpetrated against the citizens of [[Dalron IV]] by Imperial personnel. Colmar had joined the Imperial Army to protect the citizens of the Empire against anarchists and other external threats.<ref name="GG9" />

Unable to reconcile the reality of what he has seen with his ideals, Colmar deserted and joined the Rebel Alliance, where he attained the rank of Lieutenant. As an Alliance soldier, Colmar often came face to face with Imperial units in which he had once served. Colmar proved instrumental in eliminating several of these units.<ref name="GG9" />

==Personality and traits==
Davaire Colmar had a strong sense of duty, which was what drove him to join the Rebel Alliance. Colmar had an aura of quiet and competence about him.<ref name="GG9" />

==Skills and abilities==
Davaire Colmar was a skilled, experienced soldier, with extensive knowledge of Imperial Army procedures and tactics. Colmar was also highly skilled with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] vehicles, and could pilot almost any such craft.<ref name="GG9" />

==Equipment==
Davaire Comar usually carried a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]] [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol|DL-18 blaster pistol]], a [[Hold-out blaster/Legends|hold-out blaster]], and a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]].<ref name="GG9" />
